text:
jess: Postmortem follow-up from the PM-2023 incident — consolidated action list below. Proposing owners + rough due dates. Please ack or propose swaps. Actions:
1) Harden circuit-breaker (JIRA-4521)
2) Add canary to rollout pipeline (JIRA-4522)
3) Update oncall runbook (JIRA-4523)
4) Investigate recurring KV cache evictions (JIRA-4524)

omar: Ack. I'll take JIRA-4521 (circuit-breaker). Planning a small fix + tests, target EOD next Thu.

lina: I can own JIRA-4523 (runbook). Will draft a PR with steps and links to playbooks.

ian: I can pick up JIRA-4522 (canary) but want eng-platform paired. Propose RACI: Ian (R), eng-platform (C), Jess (A), Omar (I). Thoughts?

jess: Sounds good. For clarity: RACI for 4522 -> Ian (R), eng-platform (C), Jess (A), Omar (I). Please add the eng-platform alias to the ticket.

devops-bot: Created subtask JIRA-4522.1 for the canary test harness: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-4522.1

nora: I will take JIRA-4524 (KV cache evictions). Noted recurring spikes ~02:00 UTC the last 3 weeks. I'll start with KV metrics + kdump, aim to have findings by next Tue.

omar: For 4521 I'll ship a mitigation (raise CB threshold + backoff tweak) as a quickstop and follow up with the full fix. PR tomorrow morning, @ian can you review?

ian: Yep, will review. Also proposing we add a "recurrence review" checkbox to any postmortem with >2 repeats and add a weekly review card on the postmortem board. @jess can you create the weekly slot?

jess: Done — added recurrence-review action and scheduled a weekly 30m review on the postmortem board. I've created a checklist template for recurrence investigations. :white_check_mark:

lina: PR for runbook draft: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/888 — includes steps, escalation matrix, and a short test plan.

jess: Thanks. Final request: when you finish a remediation, add a comment "remediation-verification" on the ticket with the deployment SHA and tag @pm-oncall so we can close the postmortem. Quick notes: keep fixes scoped for rollout (canary -> partial -> full), and for any cross-team work open a subtask and align owners. :thumbsup:

omar: Acked and will add the verification comment after deploy.

nora: Will include time-series snapshots and a reproduction attempt in my ticket before Tuesday.

jess: Great — if anyone needs help reassigning or splitting a task, call it out here and I'll coordinate handoff. Closing this thread for new owners in 24h unless someone asks to swap.
